name: PDF as vectors
description: The same pages through the Windows spooler drawn by PDFium as vectors, which a job asks for with rendering Vector, and then as one bitmap a page, which is the default. Compare the sheets and the spool file sizes: drawn, the text is as sharp as the printer can make it and the job is a fraction of the size. The label pair repeats the comparison on the 4 by 6 inch label with smoothing off, which is where a driver's own halftoning of the bars shows. The Windows in-box engine renders bitmaps only, so its job reports Rendering as dropped.
